svg.title: Memory cell
svg.desc: Compact memory lymphocyte with large nucleus, narrow deep-blue cytoplasm, and a small activation-memory marker. Biological basis: Quiescent memory lymphocytes resemble small resting lymphocytes but retain long-lived antigen-experienced receptor states.
